# CMS standards vectors

The files in `rfc9882/` are copied byte-for-byte from RFC 9882 Appendix B.
Their signer certificates are from RFC 9881 Appendix C.3.  The files in
`composite-draft05/` are from Appendix B of
`draft-ietf-lamps-cms-composite-sigs-05`; its signer certificate is the `x5c`
value for the same profile in `draft-ietf-lamps-pq-composite-sigs-19`.

`bouncycastle-1.84/` contains CMS generated by Bouncy Castle 1.84.  Its
attached direct-signature matrix covers every ML-DSA and SLH-DSA parameter set
and the 17 Composite profiles implemented by openHiTLS.  Generation and BC
verification were performed outside this repository.  The three SHA-256 profiles
explicitly select the Table 1 digest because BC 1.84 otherwise emits SHA-512.
The embedded leaf certificates share `ca_cert.pem`.  Generation used Java 21
and these Maven artifacts:

```text
org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk18on:1.84  64d6c5a6121fcd927152dd182cbed39afe0fda641a970d9bcc0c9cb1858b2731
org.bouncycastle:bcpkix-jdk18on:1.84  c87f16ed9e5ec61bc94151e9f3646ac44e50cd448121ce84367fa4b7ec7ec1bb
org.bouncycastle:bcutil-jdk18on:1.84  b374e16963421fb9cfb01cc20d7ad8fd2f8b8188e3eef0ec0a8965e245f7619a
```

Representative vectors cover detached content, signed attributes, and mixed
signers identified by SubjectKeyIdentifier.  Negative vectors cover digest,
signature, content, signed-attribute, and multi-signer failures.

The HSS/LMS vectors use SHA-256/32-byte, height-5, Winternitz-8 keys from
Bouncy Castle 1.84.  They cover LMS and two- or three-level HSS certificates,
attached or detached CMS, signed attributes, and invalid key usage.

`openhitls-bc-1.84/` contains CMS generated by openHiTLS and successfully
verified by Bouncy Castle 1.84 outside this repository.

Primary sources:

- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9882.txt
- https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9881.txt
- https://www.ietf.org/archive/id/draft-ietf-lamps-cms-composite-sigs-05.txt
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lamps-wg/draft-composite-sigs/main/src/testvectors.json
- https://www.bouncycastle.org/resources/new-releases-bouncy-castle-java-1-84-and-bouncy-castle-java-lts-2-73-11/
